mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_knowledge_doc (source_type, ref_id, title, chunk_count, status) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{refId}, #{title}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), chunk_count = VALUES(chunk_count), status = VALUES(status)

INSERT INTO t_knowledge_chunk (doc_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, token_count) VALUES
(#{docId}, #{c.chunkIndex}, #{c.content}, #{c.embedding}, #{c.tokenCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, token_count, created_at FROM t_knowledge_chunk WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY chunk_index ASC
SELECT id, doc_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, token_count, created_at FROM t_knowledge_chunk WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST (#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, doc_id, chunk_index, content, embedding, token_count, created_at FROM t_knowledge_chunk WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL AND embedding <> ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_chunk WHERE embedding IS NULL OR embedding = ''
